title_zh: iPhone 18 Pro 昨日开卖：Pro Max 仍有加价，Pro 已出现破发
content_zh:
iPhone 18 Pro 系列 9 月 18 日在中国开售。财联社记者走访上海、广州和深圳三地 Apple Store，门店外均出现排队取货；部分门店没有现货，Pro Max 的官网预计到货时间已排到 10 月中旬，Pro 相对更容易买到。

二手市场的冷热差异更明显。上海多名回收商给红色 Pro Max 256GB 报出加价约 350 至 400 元，广州红色款普遍加价 500 元以上，蓝色款开售时一度加价 1000 元、上午回落至约 550 元；深圳红色款加价约 500 至 700 元。多名回收商拒收 Pro，或只愿按原价回收，并称部分机型已经「破发」。

苹果官网显示，红色 256GB Pro 约 11 个工作日可发货，Pro Max 约需 15 个工作日；京东自营旗舰店的 Pro 多数颜色可在 1 至 2 日内发货。新机国行起售价分别为 9999 元和 10999 元，均比上一代高 1000 元。
title_en: iPhone 18 Pro Launches in China: Pro Max Commands Premium While Pro Drops Below Retail Price
content_en:
The iPhone 18 Pro series officially went on sale in China on September 18, drawing long queues at Apple Stores across Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen. While the high-end Pro Max remains in short supply—with official shipping estimates stretching into mid-October—the standard Pro model is much easier to acquire.

This supply disparity is reflected in the secondary market. Resellers are demanding premiums for the Pro Max, with the 256GB red version fetching an extra 350 to 700 RMB depending on the city. In contrast, demand for the standard Pro has plummeted, with many scalpers refusing to buy it or only offering face value, as some configurations have already fallen below official retail prices.

On Apple's official website, the red 256GB Pro has an estimated shipping time of 11 business days, compared to 15 business days for the Pro Max. Meanwhile, JD.com has most Pro colors ready to ship within one to two days. The new models start at 9,999 RMB and 10,999 RMB respectively, representing a 1,000 RMB increase over the previous generation.

title_zh: 暂停 8 天后，ChatGPT Pro 20X 限定回归
content_zh:
在暂停新订阅 8 天后，ChatGPT Pro 200 美元档（Pro 20X）已向部分符合条件的老用户开放重新购买，但新用户订阅与常规升级仍处于暂停状态。

OpenAI 帮助中心说明披露，该入口仅面向此前订阅过该计划的用户：账号需在当地时间 9 月 10 日仍持有 200 美元订阅，或其访问权限在该日期前 30 天内结束。

符合条件的用户需在权限终止后的 30 天内重新订阅，且在暂停销售期间仅有一次恢复机会。主动取消、续费失败或从 200 美元档降级至 100 美元档（Pro 5x）的用户均可参与。

此前，OpenAI 因系统算力负载压力过大，于 9 月 10 日暂停了 200 美元档的新增订阅与升级。目前 100 美元档仍正常销售，两档权益一致，仅额度分别为 Plus 的 5 倍与 20 倍。针对新用户的全面开放时间尚未公布。

🔗 相关阅读：刚刚，ChatGPT Pro 20X 限定回归
title_en: OpenAI Temporarily Revives $200 ChatGPT Pro Tier for Eligible Former Subscribers
content_en:
Following an eight-day suspension of new subscriptions, OpenAI has quietly reopened its $200 "Pro 20X" tier, but only for select former subscribers. New signups and standard upgrades for this high-end tier remain paused.

According to OpenAI's help center, this limited-time reactivation is restricted to users who held an active $200 subscription as of September 10, or whose subscription ended within the 30 days prior. Eligible users have a single opportunity to resubscribe within 30 days of their access termination. This policy covers those who manually canceled, experienced payment failures, or downgraded to the $100 "Pro 5X" tier.

OpenAI originally halted new $200 subscriptions on September 10 due to severe server and computing constraints. While the $100 tier remains available with identical features—differing only in usage limits—OpenAI has not yet announced when the $200 tier will fully reopen to the general public.

title_zh: Gemini 4 Pro 疑似现身，实测表现接近 GPT-6
content_zh:
近日，多名用户在大模型竞技场 Arena AI 的匿名对战中发现，一个标注为「Gemini 3.8 Flash」的模型在 SVG、网页、3D 场景和交互工具生成任务中的表现明显提升，部分测试结果被认为接近 GPT-6 Astra。

有测试者认为，疑似 Gemini 4 Pro 的模型在「鹈鹕骑自行车」等任务中与 GPT-6 Astra Pro 接近，但也有人更偏好 Fable 5.1 的作品质量与创意。

Google 已确认启动 Gemini 4 预训练，并称这是公司迄今规模最大的基础模型训练。

与此同时，Gemini 团队近期经历管理层调整和核心人员变动，产品重点逐渐转向代码、AI 智能体、视频多模态和企业工作流。

🔗 相关阅读：Gemini 4 Pro 疑似现身，实测表现逼近 GPT-6，Gemini 又支棱起来了？
title_en: Mystery Model Suspected to Be Gemini 4 Pro Rivals GPT-6 in Early Benchmarks
content_en:
A mysterious new model has appeared in anonymous battles on the LMSYS Chatbot Arena, sparking speculation that Google is testing its next-generation AI. Labeled "Gemini 3.8 Flash," the model has shown significant performance leaps in generating SVGs, web pages, 3D scenes, and interactive tools, with some testers claiming its capabilities rival GPT-6 Astra.

In head-to-head comparisons, such as rendering complex prompts like "a pelican riding a bicycle," the suspected Gemini 4 Pro model performed on par with GPT-6 Astra Pro. However, some users still preferred the creative output of rival models like Fable 5.1.

Google has recently confirmed that pre-training for Gemini 4 is underway, calling it the company's largest foundational model training initiative to date. This development comes amid leadership reshuffles within the Gemini team, which is reportedly pivoting its focus toward coding, AI agents, multimodal video, and enterprise workflows.

title_zh: 赛力斯回应问界专属专营：用户权益不变，将择机进军轿车和 MPV
content_zh:
赛力斯集团董事、副总裁康波首次系统回应问界转向品牌专属专营后的分工：产品定义、设计、品牌营销、渠道零售和服务体系由赛力斯主导，华为终端继续参与赋能。

《21 汽车 · 一见 Auto》援引知情人士称，问界建立独立销售网络后，仍会保留一定比例的门店在鸿蒙智行共享展厅销售；部分华为商超门店的授权主体将转为赛力斯，渠道分网计划在 2026 年 12 月 31 日前完成。相关营销分工和资源投入细节仍在商议。

他表示，问界现有 120 万用户的权益、OTA 升级和后续服务不受影响。赛力斯同时持有引望 10% 股份，问界仍会获得华为的技术、产品与供应保障。

在产品布局上，问界计划择机进入轿车、MPV 等市场，并将于 10 月亮相巴黎车展。
title_en: Seres Clarifies Aito's Exclusive Operations, Plans Entry into Sedan and MPV Markets
content_en:
Seres Group Director and VP Kang Bo has clarified the division of labor following Aito's transition to exclusive brand operations. Seres will lead product definition, design, marketing, retail, and services, while Huawei will continue to provide technological empowerment.

According to sources, even after establishing an independent sales network, Aito will maintain a presence in Huawei's Harmony Intelligent Mobility Alliance (HIMA) shared showrooms. Some Huawei mall stores will transition their authorization to Seres, with the channel separation scheduled for completion by December 31, 2026.

Kang assured that the rights, OTA updates, and services for Aito's 1.2 million existing users will remain unaffected. Furthermore, Seres' 10% stake in Huawei's subsidiary Yinwang ensures continued access to Huawei's technology and supply chain.

Looking ahead, Aito plans to expand its lineup into the sedan and MPV segments and is set to showcase its vehicles at the Paris Motor Show in October.

title_zh: 钉钉创始人陈航出任百望股份非执行董事，年薪 10 万元
content_zh:
百望股份 9 月 17 日召开临时股东大会，投票通过陈航的董事委任。公告显示，钉钉创始人陈航（花名「无招」）自当日股东大会结束后出任公司非执行董事。

陈航的年薪为 10 万元，不另行发放董事会会议津贴。他的任期将持续至当前董事会任期届满，届时可连选连任。
title_en: DingTalk Founder Chen Hang Appointed Non-Executive Director of Baiwang
content_en:
Baiwang Share announced that DingTalk founder Chen Hang (also known as "Wuzhao") has been appointed as a non-executive director of the company, effective following an extraordinary general meeting on September 17.

Chen will receive an annual salary of RMB 100,000, with no additional allowances for board meetings. His term will run until the expiration of the current board's tenure, at which point he will be eligible for re-election.

title_zh: 联想市值盘中超过美团，股价刷新高
content_zh:
9 月 18 日，联想集团股价盘中涨超 7%，最高触及 36.8 港元。截至报道发稿时，联想市值约 4554 亿港元，盘中超过美团的 4527 亿港元。这一排名随股价实时变动，不代表公司发生了并购或业务重组。

摩根士丹利 9 月 17 日的报告称，联想的通用服务器和 AI 服务器需求较强，预计 ISG 业务收入增速将继续加快，并维持「增持」评级和 46 港元目标价。
title_en: Lenovo's Market Cap Briefly Surpasses Meituan as Stock Hits New High
content_en:
Lenovo Group's shares surged over 7% during intraday trading on September 18, pushing its market capitalization to approximately HK$455.4 billion. This briefly surpassed Meituan's market value of HK$452.7 billion. The shift in ranking reflects real-time stock fluctuations and does not indicate any corporate restructuring or mergers.

The stock rally follows a positive report from Morgan Stanley on September 17, which highlighted robust demand for Lenovo's general and AI servers. The investment bank expects revenue growth for Lenovo's Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) to accelerate, maintaining an "Overweight" rating on the stock with a target price of HK$46.

title_zh: 小鹏与火山引擎合作落地 5000 个智能体，覆盖 800 多家供应商
content_zh:
火山引擎 9 月 18 日披露，小鹏集团以 HiAgent 为底座建设 AI 中台，目前已有 2000 名活跃用户，累计创建 5000 个智能体，50 个「数字员工」场景正在逐步落地。双方的合作还覆盖研发、办公、营销、座舱、智驾和安全等业务。

小鹏内部的供应链风险平台设置了 78 个风险因子，覆盖 800 多家供应商。火山引擎称，新车型产能风险排查由 2 天缩短至 10 分钟，供应商月度风险报告由 1 周缩短至 1 小时；联合开发的 AI 外呼工具则使相关人力成本下降超过 50%。

在小鹏首届 AI 公开赛中，参赛人次超过 2.1 万，其中超过半数没有编程背景，累计提交近 7000 份作品。小鹏还将豆包模型接入内部 AI-hub，并在多个业务中心推广 TRAE。
title_en: XPeng Partners with Volcano Engine to Deploy 5,000 AI Agents, Streamlining Supply Chain Management
content_en:
Chinese EV maker XPeng has partnered with Volcano Engine, ByteDance's cloud division, to build an AI hub powered by the HiAgent platform. The initiative has already attracted 2,000 active users within XPeng, leading to the creation of 5,000 AI agents and the gradual rollout of 50 'digital employee' scenarios. The collaboration spans multiple business areas, including R&D, office operations, marketing, smart cockpits, autonomous driving, and security.

A key highlight of this partnership is the optimization of XPeng's supply chain risk platform, which monitors 78 risk factors across more than 800 suppliers. With Volcano Engine's AI capabilities, the time required to assess production capacity risks for new car models has been slashed from two days to just 10 minutes. Additionally, generating monthly supplier risk reports now takes one hour instead of a week, and a co-developed AI outbound calling tool has cut related labor costs by over 50%.

XPeng is also fostering an internal AI culture, recently hosting its first AI competition which drew over 21,000 participants—more than half of whom had no programming background. Furthermore, the automaker has integrated ByteDance's Doubao LLM into its internal AI hub and is promoting the use of TRAE across various business centers.

title_zh: Anthropic 建立生物实验室，拟让 Claude 指挥机器人执行实验
content_zh:
据路透社报道，Anthropic 已在旧金山湾区建立一间湿实验室，用于测试 Claude 在生物实验中的实际能力。路透社现场看到，实验室配有培养箱、显微镜、液体处理设备和实验机器人；公司生物学研究负责人 Christina Kim 证实了实验室的存在。

Anthropic 希望让 Claude 参与设计实验，并进一步指挥机器人完成移液等操作，再根据结果调整下一轮实验。Kim 表示，现阶段仍需要人工监督，实验室也没有专门用于药物发现，具体研究疾病和进度尚未公开。

公司称，这项工作也用于评估模型在生物领域的能力与风险。目前实验室不会开展临床试验，Claude 稳定完成连续实验的能力仍待验证。
title_en: Anthropic Builds Wet Lab to Test Claude's Ability in Directing Robotic Biology Experiments
content_en:
AI startup Anthropic has established a wet laboratory in the San Francisco Bay Area to test the real-world capabilities of its AI model, Claude, in biological experimentation. According to a Reuters report, the facility is equipped with incubators, microscopes, liquid-handling equipment, and lab robots. Christina Kim, Anthropic's head of biological research, confirmed the lab's existence.

Anthropic aims to have Claude assist in designing experiments and directly command robots to perform tasks such as pipetting, subsequently adjusting subsequent experimental rounds based on the results. However, Kim noted that human supervision is still required at this stage. The lab is not currently dedicated to drug discovery, and its specific research targets remain undisclosed.

The company stated that this initiative also serves to evaluate the capabilities and potential biosecurity risks of AI models in the life sciences. The lab will not conduct clinical trials, and Claude's ability to reliably execute consecutive, multi-step experiments is still being validated.

title_zh: 巴菲特卸任伯克希尔董事长，其子霍华德接任
content_zh:
伯克希尔·哈撒韦 9 月 18 日宣布，沃伦·巴菲特即日起转任荣誉董事长，继续担任董事并向公司提供意见；其长子霍华德·巴菲特当选董事长。Susan Decker 继续担任首席独立董事。

巴菲特在致股东信中表示，Greg Abel 已经全面履行 CEO 职责并负责公司的重要决策。此次交接后，Abel 继续经营公司，霍华德负责守护伯克希尔的文化与价值观，董事长和 CEO 的职责由两人分别承担。

霍华德自 1993 年起担任伯克希尔董事，现任 Howard G. Buffett Foundation 董事长兼 CEO。巴菲特称自己将继续作为股东留在公司。
title_en: Warren Buffett Steps Down as Berkshire Hathaway Chairman, Succeeded by Son Howard Buffett
content_en:
Berkshire Hathaway announced on September 18 that Warren Buffett has stepped down as Chairman, transitioning to the role of Chairman Emeritus. The 94-year-old investing legend will remain on the board and continue to advise the company. His eldest son, Howard Buffett, has been elected as the new Chairman, while Susan Decker will continue as the lead independent director.

In a letter to shareholders, Warren Buffett emphasized that CEO Greg Abel has already fully assumed executive duties and is responsible for major corporate decisions. Following this transition, Abel will continue to run the company's operations, while Howard Buffett will focus on preserving Berkshire's unique culture and values, effectively splitting the roles of Chairman and CEO.

Howard Buffett has served on Berkshire's board since 1993 and is currently the Chairman and CEO of the Howard G. Buffett Foundation. Warren Buffett assured stakeholders that he will remain closely tied to the company as a committed shareholder.

title_zh: 比亚迪召回 18.32 万辆唐、秦车型，涉及制动灯常亮隐患
content_zh:
市场监管总局 9 月 18 日公布，比亚迪汽车工业有限公司和比亚迪汽车有限公司备案两项主动召回计划，共涉及 183211 辆国产汽车，召回自即日起实施。

其中包括 2015 年 3 月至 2022 年 1 月间生产的部分唐、全新一代唐 DM 和全新一代唐 EV，共 142895 辆；另有 2014 年 6 月至 2019 年 6 月间生产的部分秦系列汽车 40316 辆。

召回原因是部分车辆的制动踏板限位垫存在材料批次异常，长期使用后可能开裂或脱落，极端情况下会使制动踏板未踩下时制动灯常亮，向后车传递错误信号。比亚迪授权经销商将免费更换改善后的限位垫；此前已经更换的车辆无需重复处理。
title_en: BYD Recalls Over 183,000 Tang and Qin EVs Over Brake Light Hazard
content_en:
Chinese electric vehicle giant BYD is recalling 183,211 domestic vehicles due to a defect that could cause brake lights to remain continuously illuminated, the State Administration for Market Regulation announced on September 18.

The recall affects 142,895 Tang series models (including the Tang DM and Tang EV) manufactured between March 2015 and January 2022, as well as 40,316 Qin series vehicles produced between June 2014 and June 2019.

According to the regulator, a material defect in the brake pedal limit pads may cause them to crack or fall off over time. In extreme cases, this can keep the brake lights on even when the pedal is not depressed, sending misleading signals to drivers behind. BYD authorized dealers will replace the faulty parts free of charge.

title_zh: 英伟达投资的 Nscale 申请赴美上市，上半年营收同比增长 1252%
content_zh:
Nscale 9 月 18 日向美国证券交易委员会提交 S-1 文件，拟申请在纽约证券交易所上市，股票代码为「NSCL」。这家总部位于伦敦的 AI 基础设施公司尚未确定发行规模、发行价和股份数量。

文件显示，Nscale 今年上半年营收为 1.406 亿美元，去年同期为 1040 万美元，同比增长 1252%；同期净亏损从 3.689 亿美元扩大至 10.201 亿美元。公司将增长归因于更多数据中心和 GPU 部署投入使用，亏损则受到数据中心建设、GPU 折旧、人员成本和融资相关支出影响。

截至 8 月 31 日，Nscale 已投入运行的长期合同总价值约为 26 亿美元，已投入运行和已签约合同总价值合计约 1034 亿美元，对应约 46.1 万块已运行或已签约 GPU。公司称，上市募集资金将用于数据中心项目、技术开发、营运资金及日常运营。
title_en: Nvidia-Backed AI Infrastructure Startup Nscale Files for US IPO
content_en:
London-based AI infrastructure provider Nscale has filed for an initial public offering (IPO) on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol "NSCL." The Nvidia-backed company has not yet finalized the size, pricing, or share count for the offering.

According to its S-1 filing, Nscale's revenue for the first half of this year skyrocketed by 1,252% year-on-year to $140.6 million, up from $10.4 million. However, its net loss also widened significantly, growing from $368.9 million to over $1.02 billion. The company attributed the revenue surge to increased data center and GPU deployments, while the losses were driven by heavy capital expenditures, including data center construction, GPU depreciation, and personnel costs.

As of August 31, Nscale's active and signed contracts reached a total value of approximately $103.4 billion, representing around 461,000 GPUs. The company plans to use the IPO proceeds to fund data center projects, technology development, and general corporate operations.

title_zh: 环球音乐与索尼再诉 Suno，指控 v6 延续未授权训练成果
content_zh:
环球音乐集团和索尼音乐 9 月 18 日再次起诉 AI 音乐生成平台 Suno，指控其新发布的 v6 模型继续利用未经授权复制的录音制品。Suno 此前称，v6 是该公司首个完全使用授权音乐训练的模型。

两家唱片公司在诉状中主张，Suno 用旧模型产生的输出、用户偏好信号和互动数据训练 v6，而旧模型本身正是双方 2024 年首起诉讼的对象。原告还称，Suno 通过知识蒸馏等模型迁移方法让新模型继承旧模型的行为，因此无法切断与原有训练材料的关系。

Suno 尚未对新诉讼回应。华纳音乐已与 Suno 和解并建立合作，BMG、Believe 也向 v6 提供授权内容；环球音乐与索尼则继续要求法院认定新模型仍侵犯其录音版权。
title_en: Universal Music and Sony Sue AI Music Generator Suno Again Over New v6 Model
content_en:
Universal Music Group (UMG) and Sony Music have filed a new lawsuit against AI music generation platform Suno. The labels allege that Suno's newly released v6 model continues to profit from unauthorized copyrighted recordings, despite Suno's claims that v6 is its first model trained entirely on licensed music.

The plaintiffs argue that Suno trained the v6 model using outputs, user preferences, and interaction data generated by its older models, which are already the subject of an ongoing copyright lawsuit filed earlier this year. The record labels claim that Suno used knowledge distillation and other model transfer techniques to pass down the "unauthorized training" to the new model, making it impossible to sever ties with the original copyrighted materials.

While Suno has yet to respond to the new lawsuit, other industry players have taken a different approach. Warner Music Group, BMG, and Believe have already partnered with or licensed content to Suno. However, UMG and Sony remain steadfast, asking the court to rule that the new model still infringes on their copyrights.

title_zh: 宁德时代倪军：全固态电池产业化至少还需 5 年
content_zh:
宁德时代首席制造官倪军在采访中表示，全固态电池距离产业化至少还有 5 年。当前仍存在「固固界面」等基础科学问题，之后还要依次解决技术、工程、产品、价格和供应体系问题。

倪军认为，钠离子电池和凝聚态电池可以兼容现有生产线，更接近规模化应用。动力电池制造的难点则在于大规模一致性：实验室里做出单个样品，不等于能在数百万个电芯上稳定复制。

这番表态给出了宁德时代对技术路线和时间表的判断，不代表全固态电池已经确定量产节点。
title_en: CATL Executive: All-Solid-State Battery Commercialization Still At Least 5 Years Away
content_en:
Ni Jun, Chief Manufacturing Officer of CATL, stated in a recent interview that the industrialization of all-solid-state batteries is still at least five years away. The technology must first overcome fundamental scientific challenges, such as "solid-solid interface" issues, before addressing subsequent hurdles in engineering, product development, pricing, and supply chain readiness.

According to Ni, sodium-ion and condensed-state batteries are much closer to large-scale application because they are compatible with existing production lines. He emphasized that the primary challenge in power battery manufacturing lies in achieving large-scale consistency, noting that successfully creating a single prototype in a lab is vastly different from reliably replicating it across millions of battery cells.

While these remarks outline CATL's current assessment of the technology roadmap and timeline, they do not represent a confirmed schedule for mass production.

title_zh: 💡 Spirit AI 高阳：机器人「大脑」最快在 2027 年迎来 GPT-3 时刻
content_zh:
Spirit AI 创始人高阳在接受路透社采访时判断，机器人「大脑」最快会在 2027 年出现类似 GPT-3 的能力跃迁。她预计，到 2027 年年中，用户或许可以用自然语言让机器人连续完成一系列动作，而不必逐步编程。

高阳把不同场景的落地时间分开来看：工业应用约需 1 至 2 年，酒店、餐厅等简单商业服务约需 2 年，机器人进入普通家庭至少还要约 8 年。

她认为，训练数据仍是主要瓶颈。互联网文本可以大规模复制，机器人却需要在真实环境中积累动作和反馈数据；不同硬件、场景和任务之间的数据也难以直接通用。
title_en: Spirit AI Founder Predicts Robot 'GPT-3 Moment' by 2027
content_en:
Gao Yang, founder of Spirit AI, told Reuters that robot "brains" could experience a breakthrough equivalent to the "GPT-3 moment" as early as 2027. By mid-2027, users may be able to instruct robots to perform a series of continuous actions using natural language, eliminating the need for step-by-step programming.

Gao outlined different timelines for various sectors: industrial applications are expected to mature in one to two years, simple commercial services (such as hotels and restaurants) in about two years, while home adoption for ordinary households is still at least eight years away.

The primary bottleneck remains training data. Unlike internet text which can be easily scraped and copied, robots must gather physical action and feedback data from real-world environments. Furthermore, data collected across different hardware, scenarios, and tasks is currently difficult to standardize or share.

title_zh: 智谱推出 GLM-5.3-FlashX，最高输出速度达 200 tokens/s
content_zh:
智谱上线 GLM-5.3-FlashX，官方称其最高输出速度达 200 tokens/s。模型 API 已开放，Model Key 为 `GLM-5.3-FlashX`。

这次更新主要针对对话和 Agent 任务中的响应速度。智谱还称，该基础模型运行在 10 万张国产芯片组成的推理算力上。
title_en: Zhipu AI Launches GLM-5.3-FlashX with Speeds Up to 200 Tokens Per Second
content_en:
Zhipu AI has officially launched GLM-5.3-FlashX, boasting a peak output speed of 200 tokens per second. The model's API is now publicly available under the model key `GLM-5.3-FlashX`.

This update specifically targets response latency in conversational and AI Agent tasks. Zhipu AI also revealed that the foundation model is powered by an inference computing cluster utilizing 100,000 domestically produced chips.

title_zh: 阿里发布 Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash，支持 1M Token 多模态输入
content_zh:
阿里云上线 Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash，新模型可同时接收文本、图片、音频和视频，以文本输出结果。官方文档列出的上下文长度为 1M Token，最大输出为 131072 Token。

它支持 Function Calling、联网搜索和缓存，音频理解覆盖 113 种语言及方言。与只处理单一媒介的模型相比，它的重点是在一次请求中组合图文音视频内容，再调用工具完成后续任务。
title_en: Alibaba Cloud Launches Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash with 1M Token Multimodal Input Support
content_en:
Alibaba Cloud has officially launched its new multimodal model, **Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash**. The model is designed to process text, images, audio, and video inputs simultaneously, delivering text-based outputs. It boasts a massive context window of 1 million tokens, with a maximum output limit of 131,072 tokens.

Key features of Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash include support for function calling, web search, and prompt caching. Its audio comprehension capabilities are particularly robust, covering 113 languages and dialects. Unlike single-modality models, its primary strength lies in its ability to synthesize diverse media inputs within a single request and leverage external tools to complete complex downstream tasks.

title_zh: 义乌商城开卖载人飞碟，售价 80 万元、续航 15 分钟
content_zh:
一款双座载人飞碟进入义乌全球数贸中心展示销售，单价 80 万元。产品可载 1 至 2 人，飞行高度约 30 米，单次续航约 15 分钟，主要用于观光、展示等场景。

报道提到的「近 1.2 亿元订单」并非本次新成交，而是去年签下的预售协议：其中包括 68 台双座载人版和 86 台静态展示版。本次的新进展是产品进入义乌市场展示销售。
title_en: Manned Flying Saucer Debuts in Yiwu Market for 800,000 Yuan
content_en:
A two-seater manned flying saucer has officially gone on display and sale at the Yiwu Global Digital Trade Center, priced at 800,000 RMB (approximately $110,000 USD). Designed primarily for sightseeing and exhibitions, the aircraft can carry one to two passengers, reach a flight altitude of about 30 meters, and has a flight duration of roughly 15 minutes.

Recent reports of a "120 million RMB order" actually refer to a pre-sale agreement signed last year, which included 68 manned units and 86 static display models. The latest milestone is the physical product's official entry into the Yiwu market for public exhibition and direct sales.

title_zh: 魔搭上线开源贡献实践证明，模型、数据集和 AI 应用均可申领
content_zh:
魔搭 ModelScope 社区宣布「实践证明」功能正式上线。参与开源贡献并满足对应勋章条件的用户，可申请电子证书，贡献范围包括模型发布、数据集建设、创空间 AI 应用开发和社区共建。

据魔搭社区官方公众号介绍，证明中的贡献数据来自平台统计，每份证书带有唯一编号，扫码可查看贡献者的社区主页。申请入口在勋章管理页：达到申领条件后点击「下载证明」，系统会生成电子证书。

公告展示了应用开发、模型开发及技术布道贡献者的证明样例，其中签发日期包括 9 月 16 日和 17 日。证书由社区签发，记录的是平台上的开源实践成果。
title_en: ModelScope Launches "Proof of Practice" Certificates for Open-Source AI Contributors
content_en:
Alibaba's ModelScope community has officially launched its **"Proof of Practice"** feature, allowing open-source contributors to claim digital certificates. Users who meet specific badge requirements can apply for these certificates, which recognize contributions in model publishing, dataset creation, AI application development, and community co-building.

According to ModelScope, the certificates are generated based on verified platform data. Each certificate features a unique identification number and a QR code that links directly to the contributor's community profile page. Eligible users can easily download their digital certificates via the badge management page.

Issued directly by ModelScope, these certificates serve as official recognition of a developer's hands-on achievements within the open-source AI ecosystem.

title_zh: 达摩院开源 DAMO RADAR，腹部 CT 模型覆盖 146 种影像表现
content_zh:
阿里达摩院 9 月 18 日宣布开源与浙江大学医学院附属第一医院等机构开发的腹部 CT 通用模型 DAMO RADAR。相关论文已于 9 月 17 日登上《科学》；模型使用超过 40 万次增强腹部 CT 检查和 1500 万组按解剖结构对齐的图文数据训练，直接从临床报告中学习，无需额外人工标注。

RADAR 覆盖 18 个解剖结构和 146 种影像表现。研究团队在多中心数据上进行内外部评估，并安排 26 名放射科医生参与读片研究；模型辅助使医生的诊断敏感性平均提高约 10%。

项目代码以 Apache 2.0 许可证开源，预训练权重和配套文件可从 Hugging Face 下载。仓库同时提供演示数据、预测结果和训练、推理说明。
title_en: Alibaba's DAMO Academy Open-Sources DAMO RADAR, a Breakthrough Abdominal CT AI Model
content_en:
Alibaba's DAMO Academy, in collaboration with the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine and other institutions, has officially open-sourced **DAMO RADAR**, a general-purpose abdominal CT model. The research behind the model was published in the prestigious journal *Science* on September 17.

DAMO RADAR was trained on over 400,000 contrast-enhanced abdominal CT scans and 15 million anatomically aligned image-text pairs. By learning directly from clinical reports, the model eliminates the need for manual annotation. It covers 18 anatomical structures and 146 distinct imaging findings.

In multi-center evaluations and a reading study involving 26 radiologists, the AI assistant improved doctors' diagnostic sensitivity by an average of approximately 10%. The project code has been released under the Apache 2.0 license, with pre-trained weights and supporting files available on Hugging Face.

title_zh: MiniMax 开源 Code CLI
content_zh:
MiniMax 已开放 MiniMax Code CLI 的源码，当前仓库对应 0.4.12 source preview，第一方代码默认采用 MIT 许可证。项目覆盖终端交互界面、无头执行模式和 Agent Client Protocol，可读取及修改代码、运行命令和测试，也支持搜索、插件及多模态工具。

开发者可以使用 MiniMax 账号登录，也可以通过 BYOK 接入兼容 OpenAI Completions、OpenAI Responses 或 Anthropic Messages 的模型服务。官方仓库同时提供源码构建、版本证据和第三方依赖说明。

此次开源不包含 MiniMax Code 桌面端源码。桌面应用仍可单独下载，相关仓库目前只为其提供问题反馈入口。
title_en: MiniMax Open-Sources Code CLI for Developer Workflows
content_en:
Chinese AI startup MiniMax has open-sourced the command-line interface (CLI) for its coding assistant, releasing the source preview for version 0.4.12. The first-party code is licensed under the permissive MIT License.

The **MiniMax Code CLI** features an interactive terminal interface, a headless execution mode, and support for the Agent Client Protocol. It enables developers to read and modify code, execute commands, run tests, and utilize search, plugins, and multimodal tools.

Developers can access the tool using their MiniMax accounts or via a Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) model, which supports services compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic APIs. Note that this release does not include the source code for the MiniMax Code desktop application, which remains closed-source but free to download.

title_zh: 12306 回应国庆高铁票价：节假日浮动不等于票价基准上涨
content_zh:
针对国庆假期部分高铁票被质疑「涨价」，12306 客服回应称，不同日期的折扣可能随客流等因素浮动，节假日显示的价格变化并不代表票价基准上涨，实际票价以 12306 页面为准。

客服同时表示，无法保证哪一个购票时段的折扣更大。一般情况下，开票后价格不会出现很大变化，但特殊情况仍可能出现。
title_en: China Railway 12306 Clarifies National Day Ticket Price Fluctuations
content_en:
In response to public concerns over rising high-speed rail ticket prices ahead of the National Day Golden Week, China Railway's official ticketing platform, **12306**, clarified that holiday price fluctuations do not represent an increase in base fares.

According to customer service, ticket discounts vary dynamically based on passenger volume and other market factors. The final price displayed on the official 12306 platform at the time of booking is the definitive fare.

The platform added that it cannot guarantee which booking window will offer the deepest discounts. While ticket prices generally remain stable once sales open, minor adjustments may still occur under special circumstances.

title_zh: 水滴筹将平台服务费从 6% 提至 8%，单个项目上限 8000 元
content_zh:
水滴筹客服确认，平台已对 8 月 15 日起发起的筹款项目调整收费标准，平台服务费从筹款金额的 6% 提高到 8%，单个项目服务费上限为 8000 元；提现时还需支付 0.6% 的第三方支付通道费。

一名患者家属披露的提现页面显示，6831 元筹款被收取 546.48 元服务费和 41.04 元通道费。平台称，特困人群可免收服务费，灾害、重大事故等特殊情况下也有相应补贴。
title_en: Chinese Crowdfunding Platform Shuidichou Raises Service Fee to 8%
content_en:
Chinese medical crowdfunding platform Shuidichou has raised its platform service fee from 6% to 8% of the total funds raised, effective for all new projects launched on or after August 15. The service fee for any single project is now capped at 8,000 RMB.

In addition to the increased service fee, users must pay a 0.6% third-party payment channel fee upon withdrawal. For example, a withdrawal page shared by a patient's family showed that a fundraising pool of 6,831 RMB incurred a 546.48 RMB service fee and a 41.04 RMB channel fee.

Shuidichou stated that the service fee can be waived for individuals in extreme poverty. The platform also offers subsidies for special circumstances, such as natural disasters and major accidents.

title_zh: 迪士尼任命首位 CTO，Character.AI 前 CEO Anand 加盟
content_zh:
迪士尼宣布任命 Karandeep Anand 为公司首位 CTO。他将直接向新任 CEO Josh D’Amaro 汇报，负责基础设施、产品、工程以及数据和 AI 平台团队。

Anand 此前担任 Character.AI CEO 一年多，推动这家 AI 聊天机器人公司拓展微短剧业务。迪士尼去年曾向 Character.AI 发出停止侵权通知，指控其工具未经授权使用受版权保护的角色形象；如今又从该公司引入技术负责人，显示迪士尼正在重新整合 AI、数据和产品技术团队。
title_en: Disney Appoints First CTO, Hiring Former Character.AI CEO Karandeep Anand
content_en:
Disney has appointed Karandeep Anand as its first-ever Chief Technology Officer (CTO). Anand will report directly to the newly appointed CEO, Josh D’Amaro, and will oversee teams responsible for infrastructure, product, engineering, as well as data and AI platforms.

Anand previously served as the CEO of Character.AI for over a year, where he drove the AI chatbot startup's expansion into micro-dramas.

This high-profile hire comes after Disney sent a cease-and-desist letter to Character.AI last year, accusing the startup of using its copyrighted characters without authorization. Bringing Anand on board signals Disney's aggressive push to consolidate and upgrade its AI, data, and product technology teams.

title_zh: One Fun Thing｜好莱坞标志变成《速度与激情》投影幕
content_zh:
最近，好莱坞山上的白色大字亮起了《速度与激情》的影像。环球影城与好莱坞商会合作，使用投影映射技术，把电影片段和新过山车画面投到标志的字母上，为 Fast \& Furious: Hollywood Drift 开业宣传。

这处标志 1923 年最初写的是「Hollywoodland」，用于宣传房地产项目，后来才成为洛杉矶的城市象征。如今，巨大的字母又接到一份广告工作：给赛车和过山车当投影幕。
title_en: One Fun Thing | Hollywood Sign Transformed into "Fast & Furious" Projection Screen
content_en:
The iconic white letters of the Hollywood sign recently lit up with action-packed scenes from the *Fast & Furious* franchise. In a collaboration between Universal Studios and the Hollywood Chamber of Commerce, advanced projection mapping technology was used to beam movie clips and roller coaster footage directly onto the landmark.

The high-tech stunt was designed to promote the upcoming launch of the "Fast & Furious: Hollywood Drift" roller coaster.

Originally erected in 1923 as "Hollywoodland" to advertise a local real estate development, the sign eventually became the ultimate symbol of Los Angeles. Now, the historic letters have taken on a new advertising gig, serving as a giant canvas for high-speed cars and roller coasters.

title_zh: 周末看什么｜《The History of Concrete》沿着混凝土走进纽约日常
content_zh:
John Wilson 在 HBO 纪录系列《How To with John Wilson》之后拍出的首部纪录长片，把镜头对准混凝土。他先去参加 Hallmark 的编剧课程，试图学会如何为一部混凝土电影筹资，随后把纽约的施工、漏水、桥梁和住房串进同一趟观察。

影片延续了他从日常细节里寻找联系的拍法。Wilson 在《纽约客》采访中说，他会从每天的素材中剪出自己喜欢的十秒片段，再围绕采访骨架寻找过渡影像。《纽约客》的权威影评认为，电影通过这些发现，把基础设施和人的生活联系起来。

这部 101 分钟的纪录片由 Magnolia 发行，9 月 18 日起在纽约 IFC Center 放映。9 月 19 日的部分场次安排了 Wilson 映后问答或延长导言。
title_en: Weekend Watch: John Wilson’s 'The History of Concrete' Explores the Fabric of New York Life
content_en:
Following his acclaimed HBO docuseries *How To with John Wilson*, filmmaker John Wilson returns with his first feature-length documentary, *The History of Concrete*. The film begins with Wilson attending a Hallmark screenwriting course to learn how to pitch a movie about concrete, before embarking on a visual journey that weaves together New York City's construction sites, water leaks, bridges, and housing.

True to his signature style, Wilson uncovers profound connections within mundane daily details. In an interview with *The New Yorker*, he revealed his process of selecting favorite ten-second clips from daily footage to bridge his interview segments. Critics have praised the film for masterfully linking urban infrastructure with the human experience.

Distributed by Magnolia Pictures, the 101-minute documentary begins its theatrical run at New York's IFC Center on September 18. Select screenings on September 19 will feature post-screening Q&As or extended introductions with Wilson.

title_zh: 买书不读指南｜《重新回到生活》追问技术如何改变工作与情绪
content_zh:
中国人民大学哲学院教授王小伟在《重新回到生活：科技时代的工作、情绪、爱情和死亡》中，从自己的技术感受出发，讨论效率与理性如何进入工作、情绪、爱情和死亡。

他把日常体验与卢梭、尼采、雅思贝尔斯等人的思想放在一起，追问深度技术化的生活里，体感与意义感如何被改变。书的立场围绕「保卫日常生活」展开，同时保留了作者作为技术使用者的具体困惑。

该书由中信出版集团于 2026 年 8 月出版。
title_en: Book Recommendation: 'Returning to Life' Questions How Technology Reshapes Work and Emotion
content_en:
In his book *Returning to Life: Work, Emotion, Love, and Death in the Age of Technology*, Wang Xiaowei, a philosophy professor at Renmin University of China, explores how efficiency and rationality have permeated the core aspects of human existence. Drawing from his personal experiences with technology, Wang examines the shifting boundaries of work, emotion, love, and mortality.

By juxtaposing everyday experiences with the philosophical insights of thinkers like Rousseau, Nietzsche, and Karl Jaspers, the book questions how our physical sensations and sense of meaning are altered in a deeply digitized world. At its heart, the book is a defense of daily life, capturing the author's personal dilemmas as an ordinary technology user.

The book is published by CITIC Press Group.

title_zh: 游戏推荐｜《林间小世界》随手画出拱门与城堡
content_zh:
《林间小世界》（Tiny Glade）是一款无网格的建筑游戏。画一条穿过墙壁的小路，墙面会自动生成拱门；把墙加宽，会出现立柱；压低墙体，又会变成篱笆或普通门。砖石和木材随玩家操作重新组合。

Pounce Light 开发的这款作品没有管理任务、战斗或失败条件。藤蔓爬上建筑，绵羊在附近走动，夜间则有萤火虫。游戏于 2024 年 9 月发行，目前 Steam 页面列出 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 支持，简体中文评测为「好评如潮」。
title_en: Game Recommendation: Build Cozy Castles and Arches in 'Tiny Glade'
content_en:
*Tiny Glade* is a gridless, relaxing building game developed by Pounce Light. The game features an intuitive, procedural building system: drawing a path through a wall automatically generates an arch, widening a wall spawns pillars, and lowering it turns it into a fence or a gate. Bricks, stone, and wood seamlessly adapt to the player's every move.

Designed as a stress-free experience, *Tiny Glade* features no management tasks, combat, or failure conditions. Players can watch ivy climb up their creations, sheep wander through the meadows, and fireflies light up the night.

Released in September 2024, the game is available on Steam for Windows, macOS, and Linux, where it has received 'Overwhelmingly Positive' reviews from players.
